title: Satori project settings
description: Settings of Satori that belong to the project and are shared through the repository.

architecture.description: The layers of the architecture, how a class is placed in one, and which dependencies between layers are allowed. Without it Satori uses View, State, Service and Model.

preset.description: A ready-made architecture to start from. The layers and rules below are merged into it: a layer with the same id adds its folders, names and extends and replaces its label and colour; a layer with a new id is added.
enumDescriptions: View, State, Service and Model, placed by Satori's own guess.
Clean Architecture: presentation and data depend on the domain, the domain on nothing.
MVVM: views use view models, view models use the model.
One layer per folder of lib/ (or lib/src/), read from the project. No rule is applied until "rules" asks for one.

layers.description: The layers, in the order of the flow (the first one uses the following ones).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter.

label.description: The name shown in the diagram.

description.description: A sentence for the legend and the tooltips.

color.description: The colour of the layer, as #rrggbb. A colour of the palette is used without it.

folders.description: Classes in these folders belong to the layer. Globs relative to the project: ** crosses folders, * stays in one.

extends.description: Classes that extend, implement or mix in one of these belong to the layer.

names.description: Classes whose name matches belong to the layer: *Page (ends with), Base* (starts with), *Repo* (contains).

neutral.description: A layer that takes no part in the rules (shared code, utilities). Libraries and whatever matches nothing go here. Only one layer can be neutral; one called "other" is added when none is.

rules.description: Which dependencies between layers are allowed.

mode.description: "order": a layer may use the ones after it in the list, and using one before it is a violation. "allow": only the pairs in "allow" are permitted. "none": no rule, the layers only group the classes.

allow.description: Pairs [from, to] that are permitted. In "order" mode they are exceptions to the order.

forbid.description: Pairs [from, to] that are always a violation.

overrides.description: Classes placed by hand: the name of the class and the id of its layer.

heuristic.description: What to do with Satori's own guess (view, state, service, model, utility) for classes that no rule places. false switches it off; an object maps each guess to a layer of this architecture.
